newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to launch new motorway construction tenders.
newsitem.headline: Poland to launch new motorway construction tenders.

text.p: Poland will launch new tenders within the next few months in its $8 billion scheme to build 2,500 km of toll motorways, the head of the government's Agency for Motorways Construction said on Thursday.

Andrzej Patalas said his priority was to invite bids for construction of the crucial motorway between the central city of Lodz and Terespol on the border with Russia but he needed Planning Ministry approval for the exact route before launching the tender. @

"We can open the tender for the motorway construction two weeks after we get localisation approval from the Planning Ministry," Patalas told a news conference, adding that he hoped the decision would be made this year.
The motorway tender is being delayed by vocal protests from residents of Warsaw's southern districts, which the road is tentatively planned to cross.

The Lodz-Terespol stretch -- together with a motorway linking the German border town of Swiecko and Lodz for which a tender has already been opened -- would be part of a route connecting Paris and Moscow via Berlin and Warsaw. @

Patalas said that if it proved impossible quickly to open the Lodz-Terespol tender his agency was instead likely to invite bids for construction of motorways between Lodz and the central city of Torun and between the western city of Wroclaw and Poland's border with Germany.
Under the motorway construction programme, passed by parliament in 1994, consortia of Polish and foreign firms are invited to public tenders to build sections of motorways. @

The government will finance 15 percent of the construction costs, mainly to buy land, while the rest of the finance will come from the consortia, which would be entitled to collect tolls for 25 to 30 years on the sections they have built.
Patalas said the consortium to build the 360-km Swiecko-Lodz motorway would probably be chosen in the first quarter of 1997.
The winner of a tender to construct a 150-km link between the Baltic port of Gdansk and Torun would be announced in mid-1997, he said. @
The tender to construct a short motorway stretch between the southern cities of Krakow and Katowice would be resolved late this year or early in 1997, he added.
